implemented_scope: alpha.0.112 corrective: fixes the remaining PRO Server startup regression exposed by alpha.0.111. IntegrationRuntimeProperties is an immutable Java record with both a canonical constructor and a compatibility constructor; Spring Boot therefore cannot implicitly select constructor binding and falls back to JavaBean instantiation, which fails with "No default constructor found". The canonical record constructor is now explicitly annotated with @ConstructorBinding while the compatibility constructor is preserved. Existing absent-map normalization for webhook, Jira Assets, ServiceNow and notification collections remains unchanged. Adds an architecture regression gate that requires explicit constructor selection and preserves the real ConfigData ApplicationContextRunner startup test. No API, migration, permission, capability or roadmap contract changes; PGM-10-E05 and PGM-10-E06 statuses are unchanged.

alpha.0.111 corrective: fixes the PRO Server startup regression reproduced on alpha.0.109 where Spring Boot ConfigData flattened empty YAML maps under infranexum.integrations into empty scalar values that could not bind to Map-valued IntegrationRuntimeProperties. Adds a Spring ConfigData binding regression test plus a Compose contract guard that keeps integrations enabled with zero configured providers/endpoints. No API, migration, permission, capability or roadmap contract changes; PGM-10-E05 and PGM-10-E06 statuses are unchanged.
